name: E-House
source: 2021-4591-65-1022 Rev 0, ST-CGF Topside E-House Fabrication Sequence Drawing (2 sheets, issued for information 20 Nov 2025)

decks.name: Deck level 1, Deck level 2, Deck level 3
Cable tray and supports, level 1, HVAC and ducting
Cable tray and supports, level 2, HVAC and ducting
HVAC and ducting, Stairs and ladders

steps.title: Preparation
items: Preparation of materials for cutting, beveling
Fabricate temporary supports

steps.title: Layout supports and assemble decks
items: Layout temporary support and assembly intermediate deck part 3 (E-House deck level 1)
Layout temporary support and assembly E-House deck level 2 and level 3

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Deck level 1, Deck level 2, Deck level 3

steps.title: Columns and wall on E-House level 1
items: Install columns and wall on E-House level 1

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Columns and wall on level 1

steps.title: Lift E-House deck level 2, supports for level 1
items: Site moving and lifting E-House deck level 2
Install supports for architectural, piping, E&I, HVAC for E-House level 1

steps.title: Columns and wall on deck level 2
items: Install columns and wall on E-House deck level 2
Install remaining supports for architectural, piping, E&I, HVAC below deck level 1

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Columns and wall on level 2

steps.title: Lift E-House deck level 3, supports for level 2
items: Site moving and lifting E-House deck level 3
Install supports for architectural, piping, E&I, HVAC for E-House level 2
Install beam or double plate of holding part (stair, HVAC, ducting support) which connect directly to E-House for complete install the rest structure at final position

steps.title: Level 1: hot work, painting, insulation, ducting
items: Clear hot work for E-House level 1
Touch up painting and release for install insulation
Install insulation, install ducting, cable tray, ladder for E-House level 1
Install remaining supports for architectural, piping, E&I, HVAC for deck level 2

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Cable tray and supports, level 1, HVAC and ducting

steps.title: Equipment on E-House deck level 1
items: Install equipment on E-House deck level 1 (not include transformer)

steps.title: Level 2: hot work, painting, insulation, ducting
items: Clear hot work for E-House level 2
Touch up painting and release for install insulation
Install insulation, install ducting, cable tray, ladder for E-House level 2

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Cable tray and supports, level 2, HVAC and ducting

steps.title: Equipment on E-House deck level 2
items: Install equipment on E-House deck level 2

steps.title: HVAC, stair, final painting
items: Install HVAC and ducting system for E-House (hold any part clashing with rigging arrangement)
Install stair and stair case
Touch up and final painting & marking

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: HVAC and ducting, Stairs and ladders

steps.title: Hold clashing parts for trailers
items: Hold pipe rack, cable tray, piping which is clashing with trailer and lashing arrangement
Keep main supports and release temporary supports for trailers arrangement and site moving

steps.title: Ready for site moving and lifting
items: Ready for site moving and lifting
